name: Voice
tagline: Answers the phone when you cannot

roadmap.note: Highest value and highest risk in the portfolio. Real per-minute cost, and a bad call is worse than voicemail. Under independent analysis.

marketing.summary: Forward your phone when the shop is shut or you are up a ladder. The call is answered, the question is handled from your own documents, and a booking or a callback lands in your diary.
marketing.audience: Anyone whose hands are busy during the hours customers ring, and for whom a missed call is a lost job.

features.title: Answers instead of voicemail
features.body: Most people do not leave a voicemail. They ring the next name on the list.

features.title: Knows your business
features.body: Answers from the same documents your assistant uses, so the phone and the website say the same thing.

features.title: Fails safe
features.body: When it is not sure, it takes a message and tells you - it never guesses on your behalf.

faq.q: Will it pretend to be a person?
faq.a: No. It says what it is. Customers mind being deceived far more than they mind talking to a machine that is useful.
